description: Delete a page: its URL stops working at once. The maker gets only a brief undo in the dashboard, then it is purged for good (there is no restore tool). Only use it when the human asked for deletion; to hide a page reversibly, use unpublish_page instead. Returns { ok, id, deleted }; fails with page_not_found if the id is not in this space or is already deleted.

page_id.description: The page id: the `id` field from publish_page or list_pages (also the last path segment of the page URL, …/docs/<page_id>). Only pages in the connected maker's space are visible.

name: delete_page
title: Delete a page
